runbill v0.1.1

- Larger runners are priced at GitHub's published per-size rates (Linux/Windows x64 and arm64 by core count, macOS `large`/`xlarge`, GPU) instead of `cores/2 ×` the 2-core rate; billed minutes are no longer inflated by a size multiplier. 1-core `ubuntu-slim` is detected at $0.002/min. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/reference/actions-runner-pricing
- New visual identity: isometric brick-city landing page, cube-stack logo, OG image, social preview and docs theme; Marketplace branding `box` / `blue`.
- Landing page loads faster: static font instances, hero scene built after first paint.

Action: `uses: Blackman99/runbill@v0.1.1` · Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/runbill@v0.1.1` · Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/runbill/docs/
